# Memo 5 — Mixed sources and false friends

**Re:** A realistic draft with a few errors buried in it

## Statute

The deduction is allowed by I.R.C. § 162(a); the capitalization rules are in
26 U.S.C. § 263A. The net investment income tax is imposed by § 1411(a)(1),
which reaches "net investment income for such taxable year."

## Regulations

See Treas. Reg. § 1.162-1(a) and Temp. Treas. Reg. § 1.469-5T(a). Compare
Prop. Treas. Reg. § 1.199A-1.

## Sub-regulatory guidance

Rev. Proc. 2023-34, Notice 2024-7, T.D. 9959, and PLR 202301001 are all
recognized but not verified.

## Not citations

Do not match `section 162` inside code, or the URL
https://uscode.house.gov/view.xhtml?req=granuleid:USC-prelim-title26-section162,
or Section 12 of this Plan, or Pub. L. 115-97, section 13101.

## A bad pinpoint hidden in prose

The definition at § 7701(a)(99) does not exist.
